major_events.event_label: The Thunder Crown Head Wolf Attack
major_events.description: The escalating wolf tide culminates in the assault of the Thunder Crown Head Wolf, forcing the combined resistance of the three local clans.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百六十三节：雷冠头狼

major_events.description: The Divine Investigator Tie Xue Leng and his daughter Tie Ruo Nan arrive at the Gu Yue village to investigate the murder of Jia Jin Sheng, placing Fang Yuan under scrutiny.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百七十节：铁面无私血可冷？

major_events.description: Gu Yue Qing Shu uses the forbidden Wood Charm Gu to temporarily halt Bai Ning Bing, burning his own life force to death for the clan.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百七十六节：牺牲的觉悟

major_events.description: The secret underground cemetery is found, revealing the Gu Yue First Ancestor who has transformed into a flying zombie to plot his longevity scheme.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百八十二节：血湖墓地

major_events.description: Lord Sky Crane arrives on the Iron Beak Flying Crane King to exact vengeance on the First Ancestor, instigating a destructive battle of Rank 5 entities.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百八十五节：古月一代，五大飞僵

major_events.event_label: Time Reversal via Spring Autumn Cicada
major_events.description: With the village frozen by Bai Ning Bing's self-detonation and facing execution by the Rank 5 powerhouses, Fang Yuan triggers the Spring Autumn Cicada to travel back in time.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百八十七节：时间长河唯一条，春秋蝉做舟来渡

major_events.event_label: Altering History in the Blood Dome
major_events.description: Reborn in the blood dome, Fang Yuan leverages his future knowledge to kill Tie Ruo Nan and Tie Xue Leng while trapping the two Rank 5 combatants.
Fang Yuan steals the Blood Skull Gu and Yin Yang Turnaround Gu, uses the Yin Gu to revive the self-detonated Bai Ning Bing as a female, and flees the mountain.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十八节：杀人放血心狠，因祸得福手辣！

major_events.description: Fang Yuan and the newly gender-swapped Bai Ning Bing escape the ruins of Qing Mao Mountain by drifting down the treacherous Huang Long River.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第一节：黄龙江上竹筏倾

major_events.description: The duo travels through the wilderness, surviving beast attacks and arriving at the Bai Gu Mountain to seek the White Bone inheritance.

major_events.event_label: Abduction of the Bai Clan Twins
major_events.description: Fang Yuan abducts Bai Sheng and Bai Hua, the twin heirs of the Bai Clan, utilizing them as keys and materials for the inheritance trials.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第二十三节：白骨传承（上）

major_events.description: Fang Yuan sacrifices the twin children in the refinement flame and combines their flesh with his and Bai Ning Bing's to successfully refine the Flesh Bone Unity Gu.
Posing as the bodyguards 'Hei Tu' and 'Bai Yun', Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing secure positions in the Shang Clan merchant caravan under Shang Xin Ci.
Fang Yuan manipulates a zombie beast swarm to eliminate competitors in the caravan and eliminates the rogue demonic cultivator Ding Hao.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第五十六节：丁浩，你给我出来！

major_events.event_label: Shang Clan City Purple Thorn Handoff
major_events.description: Shang Yan Fei rewards Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing with Purple Thorn Tokens for safely escorting his illegitimate daughter, granting them elite guest status.
Fang Yuan enters the Battle Arena, refines the legendary All-Out Effort Gu, and defeats the opponent Li Hao to test his new strength-based combat system.
major_events.evidence_chapter: 第九十一节：方源vs李好（上）

character_state_transitions.description: Sacrifices his life by activating the Wood Charm Gu to stop Bai Ning Bing, burning his aperture and body into a tree.
character_state_transitions.evidence_chapter: 第一百七十六节：牺牲的觉悟

character_state_transitions.description: Killed by reborn Fang Yuan in the collapsed blood dome chamber to eliminate potential future threats.
Sacrifices himself in the final clash against the zombie First Ancestor, with his remaining life force crushed in the collapsed cavern.
Self-detonated to freeze the mountain but saved by Fang Yuan using the Yin Gu of the Yin Yang Turnaround Gu, gender-swapping her into a female and dropping her aptitude to 90%.
character_state_transitions.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十八节：杀人放血心狠，因祸得福手辣！

character_state_transitions.description: Cultivation is reset to Rank 1 initial stage due to time travel via the Spring Autumn Cicada, requiring him to rebuild his path.
character_state_transitions.evidence_chapter: 第一节：黄龙江上竹筏倾

character_state_transitions.description: Thrown alive into the refinement furnace by Fang Yuan to trigger the twin-bloodline resonance required for the Flesh Bone Unity Gu.

character_state_transitions.transition: Ostracized Caravan Leader -> Recognized Clan Daughter
character_state_transitions.description: Enters the inner city with Fang Yuan's protection and officially reunites with her father, Shang Yan Fei, becoming a Shang Clan Young Master candidate.

character_state_transitions.transition: Wanted Demonic Outlaw -> Honored Shang Clan Guest
character_state_transitions.description: Acquires the Purple Thorn Token, giving him immunity to the Bai Clan's bounty while inside Shang Clan City.

character_state_transitions.transition: Rank 2 Peak Stage -> Rank 3 Initial Stage
character_state_transitions.description: Reaches Rank 3 cultivation after double-cultivating with Bai Ning Bing using the newly refined Flesh Bone Unity Gu.

character_state_transitions.transition: Moon Path Specialist -> Strength Path Practitioner
character_state_transitions.description: Builds a new combat style in the Shang City Battle Arena around Strength Path Gu, summoning beast strength phantoms.
character_state_transitions.evidence_chapter: 第八十六节：全力以赴蛊

long_form_mechanisms.description: A Rank 6 Gu containing the concept of time. The Gu Master sacrifices their body and cultivation to propel their consciousness back through the River of Time. The cicada's rapid recovery afterwards places enormous pressure on lower-rank apertures.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_chapter: 第一百八十七节：时间长河唯一条，春秋蝉做舟来渡

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Yin Yang Turnaround Gu Gender Shift
long_form_mechanisms.description: A Rank 4 healing pair (Yin and Yang Gu). Applying the Yin Gu to a male saves their life and transforms them into a female, while dropping their aptitude by 10%. The target requires the corresponding Yang Gu to reverse the effect.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十八节：杀人放血心狠，因祸得福手辣！

long_form_mechanisms.description: A Rank 4 demonic Gu designed to extract and purify the blood of slain relatives. The resulting purified blood essence is absorbed into the user's aperture, permanently raising their cultivation talent/aptitude.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十五节：那就让我成魔

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Flesh Bone Unity Gu Dual Cultivation
long_form_mechanisms.description: A unique cultivation Gu refined from twin bloodlines. Two Gu Masters with blood relations or twin status (or adapted with their own flesh) can transfer primeval essence to each other without leaving foreign aura, accelerating progress.

To withstand the massive physical strain of summoning Strength Path beast phantoms, a Gu Master must replace their organic skeleton with sturdier bones using Jade Bone Gu or Iron Bone Gu to avoid fracturing themselves.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_chapter: 第三十三节：换骨剧痛（第五更）

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: All-Out Effort Gu Beast Phantom Summoning
long_form_mechanisms.description: A legendary Rank 3 Strength Path Gu that allows the user to manifest their accumulated beast strength phantoms (e.g. boar, bear, crocodile) with a 100% success rate without wasting physical stamina.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_chapter: 第八十六节：全力以赴蛊

long_form_mechanisms.description: Gu are natural fragments of laws. Repeated usage of Strength Path Gu accumulates Strength Path Dao Marks on the Gu Master's body, permanently raising their physical baseline power but potentially interfering with other paths.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_chapter: 第九三节：法则碎片，大道之痕

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Su Shou Physician's Sterile Medical Code
long_form_mechanisms.description: A Rank 5 healing protocol requiring patients to bathe in incense-scented water and wear clean white robes. Cleanliness is mandatory to prevent external dirt or physical path Dao marks from disrupting delicate healing Gu.

continuity_observations.observation: Aperture Pressure of Spring Autumn Cicada
continuity_observations.details: The narrative consistently references the physical toll and danger that the recovering Rank 6 Spring Autumn Cicada poses to Fang Yuan's lower-rank aperture, creating a ticking time limit.
continuity_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一百七十五节：压力渐生

continuity_observations.details: The arrival of Tie Xue Leng resolves the long-standing mystery of Jia Jin Sheng's murder from earlier in Book 1, demonstrating that crimes have lingering consequences.
continuity_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一百七十节：铁面无私血可冷？

continuity_observations.observation: Bai Ning Bing's Ten Extreme Physique Doom
continuity_observations.details: The ticking time bomb of Bai Ning Bing's Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique reaching 100% fullness culminates in the freezing of Qing Mao Mountain and forces the transition to Book 2.
continuity_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十节：三战白凝冰

continuity_observations.details: The First Ancestor's plot as the founder who became a zombie explains the village's deep dark secrets and his ultimate plan of blood purification via descendants.
continuity_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一百八十五节：古月一代，五大飞僵

continuity_observations.details: Fang Zheng is saved by Sky Crane Shangren and taken to Central Continent, preserving him as a crucial future foil and connection to major Sects.
continuity_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一节：黄龙江上竹筏倾

continuity_observations.observation: Empty City Stratagem on Bai Clan
continuity_observations.details: Fang Yuan's lie that the Gu Yue Clan's main force is marching to Bai Gu Mountain exploits the outside world's ignorance of Qing Mao Mountain's actual survivor count.

continuity_observations.observation: Bounty Immunity via Purple Thorn Token
continuity_observations.details: The Purple Thorn Token from Shang Yan Fei shields the protagonists from the Bai Clan's wanted posters, illustrating the immense geopolitical dominance of the Shang Clan.
The explanation that Strength Path Dao marks interfere with light/space Gu explains the combat system's emphasis on single-path specialization.
continuity_observations.evidence_chapter: 第九十三节：法则碎片，大道之痕

style_observations.description: Fang Yuan acts with ruthless logic, using the twin children as refinement materials and justifying it purely as a necessary sacrifice for personal power.
The novel portrays the righteous path as clan-based self-preservation and the demonic path as individual self-preservation, blurring conventional moral boundaries.
style_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一百七十八节：黑白灰

style_observations.description: Characters frequently recite classical-style poetry during key moments (e.g. Bai Ning Bing's death chant, Fang Yuan's arena poetry) to reflect their core philosophies.
style_observations.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十六节：再次重生

style_observations.description: Battles are detailed as strategic exchanges of Gu combinations, resource management, and elemental counters rather than simple power displays.
Fang Yuan often uses psychological profiles and dramatic deception (e.g., crying over a roasted lamb leg to manipulate the Bai Clan leader) to secure advantages.
Cultivation progress is tightly linked to economic costs, detailing market transactions, primeval stone values, and auction dynamics in Shang Clan City.

author_postscripts.morality_controversy_response: The author adds a personal ps note responding to readers displaying 'moral superiority' ('秀道德优越感的喷子', '卫道士们'), reiterating that the novel has been explicitly tagged as '三观不正' (morally unconventional) since the introduction, and declaring that they will not abandon the novel ('太监').
author_postscripts.qingming_festival_hiatus: The author shares a ps note during the Qingming Festival announcing a three-day holiday break, scheduling the next update for Monday, April 1st.

web_scraper_watermarks.aggregator_domains: Contains frequent insertions of the aggregator site '138看书网' domain name (e.g. www.１３80０１００.cOm) in standard lines and title lines (e.g., L260, L1623).
web_scraper_watermarks.obfuscated_text: Contains obfuscated texts like '①38看书网' and '44rc。m8 9 阅 138看书网' showing standard crawler defense remnants from online platforms.

originality_risks.description: The mechanism of time travel to rewrite a failed life is a foundational trope of modern Chinese web novels, presenting risks of formulaic storytelling.
originality_risks.evidence_chapter: 第一百八十七节：时间长河唯一条，春秋蝉做舟来渡

originality_risks.description: Sacrificing relatives to improve one's bloodline or cultivation aptitude relies on a long-standing dark fantasy/wuxia trope that could be seen as unoriginal.
originality_risks.evidence_chapter: 第一百九十五节：那就让我成魔

originality_risks.description: Throwing twin siblings into a smelting furnace to forge a special item draws heavily from traditional Chinese sword-forging legends (e.g. Gan Jiang and Mo Ye).

originality_risks.risk_type: Caravan Escort to Arena Colosseum Progression
originality_risks.description: Entering a major trade hub as a caravan guard followed by fighting in a structured battle colosseum for money and prestige is a highly standardized fantasy sequence.
originality_risks.evidence_chapter: 第九十一节：方源vs李好（上）
